Road accidents claim father-son lives in separate incidents

Two separate road accidents in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar have resulted in the deaths of fathers and sons. In Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh, a speeding gas tanker ran over a family sleeping outside their home, killing a father and son and injuring a daughter. In Jehanabad, Bihar, a father and son died when the vehicle they were traveling in to take the son for cancer treatment met with an accident.
